settings.repere: Bouton · How does Carpe stop sweat and odor?
settings.text: How does Carpe stop sweat and odor?

settings.repere: Texte · Carpe stops sweat first, with a unique b
settings.text: Carpe stops sweat first, with a unique blend of ingredients developed after years of experimentation and driven by dermatologists’ feedback and expertise. Less sweat means that odorous bacteria are less able to proliferate in the armpits – which, combined with other odor-focused ingredients in Carpe, leads to a powerful deodorizing effect.

Aluminum Sesquichlorohydrate 20%, Water, C13-14 Isoalkane, Silica, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Silica Silylate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Propylene Glycol, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Aminomethyl Propanol, Ceteareth-20, Fragrance (excluded in Fragrance Free), Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Water, Coco Glycerides, Salvia Officinalis (Sage) Oil, Sodium Caproyl/Lauroyl Lactylate, Triethyl Citrate, Phenoxyethanol, Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Polysorbate 20 The US FDA requires all antiperspirants to contain aluminum salts.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is Carpe Underarm safe to use every day?
settings.text: Is Carpe Underarm safe to use every day?

settings.repere: Texte · Yes, Carpe has been thoroughly tested ov
settings.text: Yes, Carpe has been thoroughly tested over years of use, and shown to be safe and effective for everyday use. In fact, the best sweat-stopping results come from application every evening as well as every morning.

settings.repere: Texte · Yes, we test our products thoroughly. Ea
settings.text: Yes, we test our products thoroughly. Each Carpe formula is subject to rigorous irritation testing by panels of 40-50 people who wear the product for an extended period of time to confirm that there are no irritating effects. In rare cases, someone may have an allergy to a Carpe ingredient – if you experience any irritation, please stop use and contact us at help@mycarpe.com for a full refund. If you’d like, we’ll also ship you a free stick of our most gentle fragrance-free formula.

settings.text: If Carpe doesn’t work well for you, or you’re unhappy for any reason, we will fully refund your first order. For first orders under $100, there’s no need to go through the hassle of returning the product—you may keep it even after we’ve issued your refund.

settings.text: Most orders placed before 5pm Pacific Time ship on the same business day. Orders placed after 5pm PT or on a weekend/holiday will ship on the next business day.
